video_prompt: Locked-off tripod shot of ONE man alone in a home studio. He is the only person in the frame from the first frame to the last. Absolutely no one else may appear: no second person, no interviewer, no guest, no shoulder, no back of a head, no arm and no hand entering from any edge. The camera never moves, the bookshelves and the microphone never change. The man talks straight into the camera lens, serious and confiding, explaining something step by step, small natural head movements and occasional small hand gestures close to his chest.
